'''Business and economy'''
*[[Gazprom]] signs a memorandum of understanding for the development of [[Iran]]ian oil and gas fields and related infrastructure worth $40 billion. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/iran-russias-gazprom-sign-primary-deal-energy-cooperation-2022-07-19/ (Reuters)]
*The [[European Commission]] proposes a new, joint defense procurement system for EU member states. It would be operational by the end of this year, with initial funding of [[Euro sign|€]]500 million. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-kyiv-european-union-commission-fd42fe7cd7dfbf600a977eecaea1b130 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 European heat waves]]
**[[2022 United Kingdom heat wave]]
***A [[United Kingdom weather records|record]] high temperature of {{cvt|40.3|C|F}} is reported at [[Coningsby]], [[Lincolnshire]], and a record overnight minimum temperature of {{cvt|25.9|C|F}} is reported at [[Emley Moor transmitting station|Emley Moor]] transmitting station in [[West Yorkshire]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-62184978 (BBC News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-62218587 (BBC News 2)] 
***[[Scotland]] reports a record temperature of {{cvt|35.1|C|F}} at [[Floors Castle]]. Initially, the highest temperature was thought to have been set at [[RAF Charterhall]], reaching {{cvt|34.8|C|F}}. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-62225963 (BBC News)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-62230571 (BBC News 2)]
***A major incident is declared in [[London]] following a "huge surge" in fires, according to the [[London Fire Brigade]]. Several homes are destroyed in [[Wennington, London|Wennington]] on the outskirts of [[East London]]. No casualties have been reported. [[Hertfordshire]] and [[Leicestershire]] fire services also declare major incidents due to the high volume of [[Emergency telephone number|emergency calls]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/major-incident-declared-across-london-after-huge-surge-in-fires-on-uks-hottest-ever-day-12655061 (Sky News)]
**[[2022 European and Mediterranean wildfires]]
***The death toll from the [[wildfire|wildfires]] and heat wave in [[Spain]] and [[Portugal]] increases to more than 1,700 people, with more than 1,063 deaths in Portugal. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/france-spain-portugal-afflicted-heat-wildfires/story?id=86972928 (ABC News)] [https://www.axios.com/2022/07/18/heat-wave-europe-death-toll (''Axios'')] 
*At least 23 people are killed and 30 others are injured in a truck and bus crash in [[Minya, Egypt|Minya]], [[Egypt]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/22-killed-33-injured-car-crash-southern-egypt-87050858 (ABC News)]
*Flooding has killed eight people and affected more than 8,500 others in [[Maradi, Niger|Maradi]] and [[Zinder]], [[Niger]], since June, according to Civil Protection. [https://floodlist.com/africa/niger-floods-july-2022 (FloodList)]
*Four people are killed and 13 are injured after a gas explosion in [[Tianjin]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/explosions-china-beijing-tianjin-4db55a7585bc1765f80aa46f69084646 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kiribati]]
****The [[United States]] donates nearly 20,000 doses of the [[Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine]] to [[Kiribati]] through the [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://fj.usembassy.gov/the-united-states-donates-19890-pfizer-vaccine-doses-to-kiribati/ (US embassy Fiji)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Pitcairn Islands]]
****The [[Pitcairn Islands]] reports the territory's first case of [[COVID-19]] in a Pitcairn Islander who returned from medical treatment abroad. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/471218/first-covid-case-detected-on-tiny-pitcairn-islands (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|U.S. CDC]] votes unanimously to recommend the [[Novavax COVID-19 vaccine|Novavax]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for people over the age of 18 years. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2022/07/19/covid-cdc-panel-recommends-novavax-vaccine-for-adults.html (CNBC)]
*The [[Government of Nigeria|Nigerian government]] announces that [[Nigeria]] will develop a [[vaccine]] for [[lassa fever]], a [[viral hemorrhagic fever]] caused by the [[lassa virus]]. [https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-news/543710-nigeria-govt-set-to-develop-lassa-fever-vaccine.html (''Premium Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of the European Union]]
**[[Accession of Albania to the European Union]], [[Accession of North Macedonia to the European Union]]
***Negotiations on the accession of [[North Macedonia]] and [[Albania]] to the [[European Union]] begin in [[Brussels]]. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2022/07/19/historic-moment-eu-opens-accession-negotiations-with-albania-and-north-macedonia (Euronews)] 
*[[Iran–Russia relations]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] makes a [[state visit]] to [[Iran]] for talks with his Iranian counterpart [[Ebrahim Raisi]] and [[President of Turkey|Turkish president]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]]. Putin will also meet with [[Supreme Leader of Iran|Supreme Leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62218696 (BBC News)]
